metadata.name: mhm_game
metadata.description: MINI-HUNGRY-MONSTERS: idle NFT mining + turn-based battle game on Solana

instructions.name: admin_mint_mhm
docs: Admin-only: mint an MHM allocation to a designated holder wallet.
Used to seed the initial MHM holder wallets (team / treasury /
liquidity allocations) before mining supply ramps up.

accounts.name: recipient
docs: signs off on the destination.

instructions.name: buy_listing
docs: Buy a listed monster with MHM. `market_fee_bps` of the price goes to
the fee wallet, the rest to the seller; the NFT (and the monster's
unclaimed mining pot with it) transfers to the buyer.

accounts.name: seller
docs: Enforced to match the listing.

instructions.name: cancel_battle
docs: Cancel an open challenge nobody has accepted. Returns the pot to the
monster and unlocks it.

instructions.name: cancel_listing
docs: Cancel your listing: the NFT returns from escrow to your wallet.

instructions.name: claim_mining
docs: Claim everything this monster has mined so far. Mints MHM to the
current NFT holder.

accounts.name: holder_nft_token
docs: Proof of ownership: the holder's token account for this monster's NFT.

instructions.name: claim_timeout
docs: If your opponent let the 90 second clock run out without submitting
(and you did submit), claim the win. If BOTH sides went silent,
either player can call this to end the battle as a draw.

instructions.name: commit_buy_monster
docs: Buy a monster with MHM, step 1 of 2: pay and commit. `burn_bps` of the
price is burned (deflationary sink); the rest goes to the fee wallet.
Traits are revealed later by `reveal_monster`.

accounts.name: payer_mhm_ata
docs: Buyer's MHM account; the purchase price is taken from here.

instructions.name: commit_hatch_genesis
docs: Genesis hatch, step 1 of 2: pay SOL and commit. This bootstraps the
economy before any MHM circulates; supply is capped by
`genesis_remaining`. The monster's traits are NOT decided here — they
are sealed to a future slot's hash and revealed by `reveal_monster`,
which prevents rarity grinding.

instructions.name: create_battle
docs: Open a battle challenge. HIGH RISK: the monster's entire unclaimed
mining pot goes on the line the moment the challenge is created.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time setup: creates the global config and the MHM coin mint
(authority = config PDA, so only this program can mint MHM).

accounts.name: program
docs: This program, used to prove the initializer is the deploy authority.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's upgrade-authority record. Constraining `initialize` to
the upgrade authority closes the deploy-time front-running window where
an attacker could otherwise call `initialize` first and seize admin.

instructions.name: join_battle
docs: Accept an open challenge with your own monster. Turn 1 starts now;
both players have 90 seconds per turn to submit actions.

instructions.name: level_up
docs: Level up a monster (+1 level, up to MAX_LEVEL), raising its battle
stats. The MHM cost scales with rarity and current level (cheap for low
tiers, steep for high tiers) and is paid to the fee wallet.

accounts.name: holder_nft_token
docs: Proof of ownership: the holder's token account for this monster's NFT.

accounts.name: holder_mhm_ata
docs: Holder's MHM account; the level-up cost is taken from here.

instructions.name: list_monster
docs: List a monster for sale at an MHM price. The NFT moves into a program
escrow until the listing is bought or cancelled. The monster keeps
mining while listed — its unclaimed pot travels to the buyer.

accounts.name: escrow_nft_token
docs: Escrow token account holding the NFT while listed; owned by the
listing PDA so only the program can release it.

instructions.name: reveal_monster
docs: Hatch step 2 of 2: reveal a committed monster's traits and mint the NFT.
Seeds the roll from the hash of the committed `target_slot` (produced
after the commit, so unpredictable at payment time), then rolls rarity
and stats, mints the single NFT to the minter, attaches metadata, and
revokes the mint authority. Only the original minter may reveal (they
receive the NFT). The reveal must land within REVEAL_WINDOW_SLOTS of the
target; miss it and the hatch expires and the payment is forfeit.

accounts.name: pending
docs: The committed hatch. Closed at the end, rent back to the minter.
Only the original minter may reveal (they receive the NFT).

accounts.name: metadata
docs: canonical metadata PDA for the monster mint.

instructions.name: settle_battle
docs: Pay out a finished battle and unlock both monsters. Permissionless
crank — anyone can call it once a winner is decided.
WINNER TAKES ALL: the loser's entire staked mining pot is minted as
MHM straight to the winning player's wallet, and the winner's own pot
returns to their monster's unclaimed balance. On a draw both pots
simply return home.

accounts.name: winner_mhm_ata
docs: The winning player's MHM token account (required unless the battle
was a draw). Loot is minted here.

accounts.name: fee_mhm_ata
docs: The fee wallet's MHM token account (required when a battle rake is
configured and there is a winner). The rake is minted here.

instructions.name: submit_action
docs: Submit this turn's actions: one CONSUMABLE (DPS / DEF / HP+) and
optionally one SUPPORT (SUPP) to boost it. Pass `support = 255` for
no support. When the second player submits, the turn resolves
immediately in the same transaction.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Admin knob-turning: mining speeds, prices and odds are still being
tuned, so they are updatable without redeploying.

types.name: Battle
docs: One battle between two monsters. Index 0 = challenger, 1 = joiner.

fields.name: players
docs: Wallets in control of each side (snapshotted when each side locks in).

fields.name: monsters
docs: Monster NFT mints on each side.

fields.name: pots
docs: micro-MHM at stake per side: the monster's whole unclaimed mining pot.

fields.name: rarity
docs: Fighter inputs snapshotted per side (rarity index, level, base stats),
so effective stats + traits can be built once both sides are known.

fields.name: winner
docs: 0 or 1 = winning side, DRAW (2) = draw, NONE_U8 = undecided.

fields.name: winner
docs: 0 or 1 = winning side index, 2 = draw.

types.name: Combat
docs: The mutable state of a single turn-based fight between two monsters. Shared
by the quick pot-stake `Battle` and each game of an NFT-staked `Match`, so
the combat engine (see `combat.rs`) has one implementation.
Per-side stats are the effective (level-scaled, trait-adjusted) values
computed by `combat_stats::fighter` when the two sides lock in.

fields.name: speed
docs: Attack speed; the faster side lands its DPS first each turn.

fields.name: dmg_bonus_bps
docs: Trait bonus to DPS damage vs the opponent, in basis points.

fields.name: defense_pierce_bps
docs: Fraction of the opponent's defense ignored on DPS, in basis points.

fields.name: always_first
docs: Strike-first override (UNIQUE trait vs lower rarity).

fields.name: def_buff
docs: Temporary defense buff from DEF actions.

fields.name: def_buff_turns
docs: Turns the defense buff has left.

fields.name: deadline
docs: Unix time by which both players must have submitted this turn's actions.

types.name: GameConfig
docs: Global game configuration. Single PDA, seeded by [CONFIG_SEED].
All economy numbers (mining ranges, prices, rarity odds) live here so the
admin can tune them without redeploying the program — the exact mining
speeds are still under discussion.

fields.name: mhm_mint
docs: The MHM coin mint (PDA, authority = this config account).

fields.name: fee_wallet
docs: Wallet that receives ALL fees: genesis SOL payments, the non-burned
share of MHM monster purchases, and the battle rake.

fields.name: burn_bps
docs: Share of the MHM monster price that is burned (basis points).
The remainder is transferred to `fee_wallet`'s MHM account.

fields.name: battle_fee_bps
docs: Rake taken from battle loot (basis points), sent to `fee_wallet`.

fields.name: market_fee_bps
docs: Fee on marketplace sales (basis points), sent to `fee_wallet`.

fields.name: level_up_base_cost
docs: Base MHM (micro-MHM) cost unit for leveling up a monster; the actual
cost scales by rarity and current level (see combat_stats::level_up_cost).

fields.name: monster_price_mhm
docs: Price in micro-MHM to buy (hatch) a new monster with MHM.

fields.name: genesis_price_lamports
docs: Lamport price for genesis hatches (bootstraps the economy before MHM circulates).

fields.name: genesis_remaining
docs: How many genesis (SOL-priced) hatches remain.

fields.name: mining_rate_ranges
docs: Mining speed ranges per rarity, in micro-MHM per hour: [min, max].

fields.name: rarity_weights_bps
docs: Rarity roll weights in basis points (must sum to 10_000).

fields.name: metadata_base_uri
docs: Base URI for NFT metadata; the rarity slug + ".json" is appended
(e.g. "<base>/epic.json"). Tunable via update_config.

fields.name: monsters_minted
docs: Total monsters ever minted (also used as the next monster id).

fields.name: battles_created
docs: Total battles ever created (also used as the next battle id).

fields.name: fee_wallet
docs: Wallet that receives all fees (genesis SOL, MHM purchase fees, battle rake).

fields.name: burn_bps
docs: Share of MHM monster purchases that is burned, in basis points.

fields.name: battle_fee_bps
docs: Rake on battle loot, in basis points.

fields.name: market_fee_bps
docs: Fee on marketplace sales, in basis points.

fields.name: level_up_base_cost
docs: Base micro-MHM cost unit for leveling up (scaled by rarity + level).

fields.name: metadata_base_uri
docs: Base URI for NFT metadata (should end with '/'); "<rarity>.json" is appended.

types.name: Listing
docs: A marketplace listing: the monster NFT sits in a program escrow until the
listing is bought (price paid in MHM) or cancelled. PDA seeded by the
monster mint, so a monster can have at most one live listing.
The monster keeps mining while listed — its unclaimed pot travels with it
to the buyer, and is part of what's being priced.

fields.name: price
docs: Asking price in micro-MHM.

types.name: Monster
docs: On-chain state for one MINI-HUNGRY-MONSTER NFT.
The NFT itself is an SPL mint with supply 1 / decimals 0; whoever holds
that token owns the monster (so monsters trade on any SPL marketplace).
This PDA (seeded by the mint) carries the game data.

fields.name: mint
docs: The SPL mint of this NFT.

fields.name: level
docs: Level (1..=MAX_LEVEL). Raises battle stats; leveled via `level_up`.

fields.name: mining_rate
docs: Mining speed in micro-MHM per hour.

fields.name: last_settled_ts
docs: Timestamp mining last settled from.

fields.name: unclaimed
docs: Mined-but-unclaimed micro-MHM banked on this monster.
THIS is the pot an opponent wins if they beat this monster in battle.

fields.name: in_battle
docs: While in a battle the monster is locked: no claiming, no other battles.

fields.name: battle
docs: The battle this monster is locked into (default Pubkey when not in battle).

types.name: PendingAction
docs: A player's selected actions for the current turn.

fields.name: consumable
docs: Action id from the catalog; must be a CONSUMABLE-slot action.

fields.name: support
docs: Action id from the catalog; must be a SUPPORT-slot action, or NONE_U8.

types.name: PendingMint
docs: A hatch that has been paid for and is awaiting its randomness reveal.
Commit–reveal defeats mint-roll grinding: payment is taken now, but the
monster's traits are seeded from the hash of `target_slot` — a slot that
does not yet exist at commit time, so the outcome cannot be predicted (or
aborted-and-retried within one atomic transaction). Once `target_slot` is
produced its hash is fixed, so the minter cannot re-roll a paid commit;
abandoning it just forfeits the payment.

fields.name: target_slot
docs: Slot whose hash seeds the roll (commit_slot + REVEAL_DELAY_SLOTS).
